name: Varad Parte
intro: I build AI systems that turn unstructured documents and enterprise data into searchable knowledge, structured outputs, and reliable workflows.
about: My work spans LLM engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and agentic automation. I build with Python and Azure, with an emphasis on grounding, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop review.

points: Built an internal AI document-intelligence platform using Azure Document Intelligence, OCR, Python, and structured metadata extraction to convert scanned lease PDFs into searchable enterprise knowledge.
Designed and developed custom AI skills that compress recurring IT and business workflows into repeatable, agent-executable tasks, cutting manual effort on routine internal processes.
Built an internal AI Wiki that makes enterprise data AI-ready, structuring business context so AI agents executing business tasks retrieve grounded information rather than inferring it.
Partner with IT stakeholders to deliver strategic AI improvements across Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Logic Apps, Power BI.

Designed document-ingestion and extraction workflows to normalize OCR output, segment legal clauses, capture metadata, and extract lease terms, dates, and escalation schedules, reducing manual review time by over 53%.

Developed and supported internal business applications using SQL, Python, REST APIs, and database-backed workflows across multiple enterprise teams, improving reliability through expanded QA and audit coverage and contributing to a 27% reduction in application downtime.

Partnered with leasing stakeholders, QA teams, and senior engineers to translate business workflows into automation and validation logic, and built deployment workflows with Python, Power Automate, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD across Dev → QA → Production.

projects.title: Enterprise GenAI Risk & Sentiment Monitoring Platform
projects.summary: A GenAI platform that turns web and news coverage into entity-matched sentiment signals, reputational-risk assessments, and stakeholder-ready reports.
points: Built a GenAI platform that aggregates web and news sources, performs entity matching, and runs diagnostic models to classify sentiment and reputational-risk signals, generating stakeholder-ready reports.
Designed a modular backend using FastAPI, Celery, Redis, and PostgreSQL with provider abstraction, deduplication, confidence-based entity resolution, and structured, auditable metadata.
Implemented LLM-assisted classification, retrieval, alerting/observability signals, and schema-validated structured-output pipelines to support summarization, human review, and decision-making.

projects.title: Multi-Agent AI Assistant for Project Management
projects.summary: A tool-using AI assistant that coordinates Jira operations, ticket routing, and workload distribution through natural-language queries.
points: Architected a multi-agent, tool-using AI assistant with CrewAI, Langflow, and LLM-based orchestration to coordinate Jira operations, ticket routing, and workload distribution.
Built a GPT-based conversational assistant with persistent memory and retrieval to provide project status, dependency insights, and risk-aware natural-language queries.
Designed reusable prompts, context flows, and retrieval patterns that reduced manual project-management effort by 40%.

projects.title: Full-Stack Hackathon Operations Platform
projects.summary: An event operations platform supporting registration, judging, and live-event workflows for hundreds of participants.
projects.description: Built a full-stack event operations platform (Next.js, Node.js, KeystoneJS, GraphQL) supporting registration, judging, and live-event workflows for hundreds of participants.
